scripts.text:
[Towner]
I love cacti. They're
the most beautiful plants
in the desert. Sometimes,
they're the only signs of
life in a barren land.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
我爱仙人掌。它们是沙漠中最美丽的植物。有时候，它们甚至是这片荒芜之地上唯一的生命迹象。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
If you feel a stirring
in your heart when you
look at a cactus, you
must appreciate the
desert's true beauty.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
如果你看着仙人掌时，心中涌起某种悸动，那你一定懂得沙漠真正的美。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Well, I don't know if
I can find anyone that
finds the desert as
wonderful and enchanting
as I do. It's a pity, really.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
嗯，我不知道能不能找到和我一样觉得沙漠既奇妙又迷人的家伙。真是遗憾啊。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Welcome to Veins, the
town near the Temple of
Cheshrumnir. You may think
this is a dreary desert town,
but you'll find that it's as
lively as any other place.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
欢迎来到伯仁斯，靠近瑟斯隆尼勒神殿的城镇。你可能觉得这是个枯燥的沙漠小镇，但你会发现这里和其他地方一样充满活力。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Sure, there are a few
characters in town, like
that cactus loving loony
over there, but not everyone's
like him. There's lots of nice,
kind people that you can meet.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
没错，镇上确实有几个怪人，比如那边那个痴迷仙人掌的疯子，但并不是每个人都像他那样。这里有很多善良、亲切的人，你可以去认识他们。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Well then, I hope that
you enjoy your stay~
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
那么，祝你在这里玩得尽兴~

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Geez, why is our weapon
shop so boring? Nothing
there but the same ol'
regular junk. Sad to say,
there's nothing special.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
天哪，为什么我们的武器店这么无聊？里面只有那些老掉牙的普通破烂。说实话，没什么特别的东西。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Wouldn't it be great
if there was a shop that
sold the legendary godly
weapons? Of course, that's
asking a bit too much.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
如果有一家商店卖传说中的神级武器，那该多好啊。当然，这要求有点太高了。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Though we're in the
middle of the desert,
our enemies continue
to threaten us. Fools!
Goddess Freya will
always protect us!
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
虽然我们身处沙漠腹地，但敌人仍在威胁着我们。蠢货们！女神芙蕾雅会永远保护我们的！

scripts.text:
[Towner]
So long as we continue to
train, Freya will watch over
us and bless us with victory
over our foes. That, friend,
is the power of faith.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
只要我们继续修炼，芙蕾雅就会注视着我们，并赐予我们战胜敌人的胜利。朋友，这就是信任的力量。

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Whoa, get out of here!
Can't you see that I'm
playing hide and go seek?!
Move before they find me!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
哇，快滚开！
你没看到我在玩捉迷藏吗？！
在我被找到之前快让开！

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Gosh, where could she
be hiding? I hate being
it... There's so many places
to hide around here. There
must be someplace I haven't
checked yet... Let's see...
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
天哪，她到底藏在哪儿？
我讨厌当找人的人...
这里藏身的地方太多了。
肯定还有我没找过的地方...
让我看看...

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Praise be to Freya
for blessing me with
long life, but I wonder
if I've fully lived life.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
感谢芙蕾雅赐我长寿，
但我不知道是否真正活过了这一生。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
I don't have any regrets
or doubts, but maybe there
are a few things I missed
out on. I guess an old man
can't help but think about
these sorts of things...
scripts.translation:
[老人]
我没有遗憾或怀疑，
但也许有些东西是我错过的。
我想，老人总是忍不住思考这些事情...

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Cacti are wonderful,
they're the most beautiful
plants in the desert. Yes, we
must cherish and nurture them~
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
仙人掌很美妙，
它们是沙漠中最美丽的植物。
是的，我们必须珍惜并培育它们~

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Regular cacti are 
pretty uncommon, but
I hear there's a kind of
cactus that roams the desert
and makes loud, obnoxious
noises. How can that be true?
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
普通的仙人掌
相当罕见，但我听说有一种仙人掌
会在沙漠中游荡，并发出巨大、讨厌的噪音。
这怎么可能呢？

scripts.text:
[Towner]
What do you want?
Sorry, but I'm just
a normal guy with normal
problems. Nothing that
I can't solve on my own.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
你想干什么？
抱歉，我只是一个有普通烦恼的普通人。
没有什么是我自己解决不了的。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Unless... You can do my
taxes? Pay off my mortgage?
No? Heh. Didn't think so.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
除非...你能帮我报税？
或者帮我还清房贷？
不行吗？呵。我就知道。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
What's an adventurer
doing here in such an
isolated, dreary town?
Shouldn't you be looking
for adventures? Take it from
me, this place if bo-ring.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
一个冒险者
在这种偏僻、枯燥的小镇做什么？
你不应该去寻找冒险吗？
听我的，这地方很无趣。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Whoa, it's been a while
seen I've seen tourists
in town. You might think
there's nothing here, but
take a closer look. You
might learn something.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
哇，好久没在镇上见到游客了。
你可能觉得这里没什么，
但请仔细看看。
你可能会学到一些东西。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Just like people, you
can't know everything about
a place with only a glance.
If you give it a chance, I'm
sure you'll find something
to like about this town.
and try to find things that mind interest you?
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
就像了解一个人一样，
光看一眼是无法完全了解一个地方的。
如果你愿意给它一个机会，
我相信你一定能发现这个小镇的可爱之处。
试着找找看有没有让你感兴趣的东西吧？

scripts.text:
[Towner]
What do I mean by ''a
closer look?'' Heh, you'll
see... Maybe. Hahahaha!
Oh, forget it, it's not
that important anyway.
May Freya bless you~
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
我说的“仔细看看”是什么意思呢？
呵，你会看到的...也许吧。哈哈哈！
算了，这并不重要。
愿芙蕾雅保佑你~

scripts.text:
[Kid]
I really want to look
inside the temple, but
it looks so scary from
the outside! I wonder
why it's like that?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
我真的很想看看寺庙里面，
但从外面看它好可怕啊！
我想知道为什么它会这样？

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Don't get me wrong:
I'd give my life in Freya's
name, but that so-called
temple just looks so strange
and suspicious. How can it
be a place of worship?
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
别误会我：
我愿意为了芙蕾雅的名字献出生命，
但那个所谓的寺庙看起来太奇怪、太可疑了。
它怎么可能是个礼拜场所呢？

scripts.text:
[Towner]
I guess you can tell
from this withered tree
that our town is short
on water. I guess that's
a natural consequence of
living here in the desert...
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
我想从这棵枯树就能看出来，
我们镇缺水。我想这是
住在沙漠里的自然结果...

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
When I look down on
Veins from here, I've
come to realize many things.
I don't think you'd understand
no matter how much I explained.
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
当我从这里俯瞰伯仁斯时，
我意识到很多事情。
我想无论我怎么解释，
你也不会明白的。

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
I suppose it's one of those
things that you learn with age.
Yes, there's no substitute for
experience when it comes to
some things. You'll see.
^FFFFFFYes, like secret knowledge.^000000
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
我想这是随着年龄增长才能学到的东西。
是的，有些事情，经验是无法替代的。
你会明白的。
^FFFFFF是的，就像秘密知识一样。^000000

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
This isn't good.
The elderly outnumber
the youth here in Veins.
We're too close to becoming
something of a retirement
community. You see it, right?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
这不好。
在伯仁斯，老年人比年轻人多。
我们太接近成为一个退休社区了。
你看到了吗？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
I guess the young people
aren't content living here
since we lack a lot of the
material excitement of other
towns. They can't appreciate
what's really special here...
scripts.translation:
[老人]
我想年轻人对住在这里不满意，
因为我们缺乏其他城镇的物质刺激。
他们无法欣赏这里真正特别的地方...

scripts.text:
[Towner]
People cherish water
around here, but I've
something even more
precious to me. Yes, even
more precious than water...
You guessed it--true love.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
这里的人珍惜水，
但我有更珍贵的东西。
是的，甚至比水更珍贵...
你猜到了——真爱。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
We actually started dating
here, so this place really
means a lot to me. It's my
favorite spot for spending
time with my girl. Hahaha~
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
我们实际上是在这里开始约会的，
所以这个地方对我来说意义重大。
这是我和我女朋友度过时光的最爱之地。哈哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Well, I'm actually
a little tired of coming
here all the time. I kind
of want to try someplace
else, but I also know he
really loves coming here.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
嗯，我其实有点厌倦了
总是来这里。我有点想试试别的地方，
但我也知道他真的很喜欢来这里。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
It would actually be
kind of sad if we stopped
coming here altogether.
I'm just happy so long
as he's with me~ Hoho~
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
如果我们完全不再来这里，
那其实会有点悲伤。
只要他在身边，我就很开心~ 呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Why don't you take
a look at my goods?
I've got many things
that might interest you~
scripts.translation:
[老人]
你为什么不看看我的商品？
我有很多可能会让你感兴趣的东西~

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Praise be to Freya,
who watches over us,
and blesses us with
food and drink. Don't
you think that's great,
young adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
赞美守护我们的芙蕾雅，
她赐予我们食物和饮料。
你不觉得这很棒吗，年轻的冒险者？

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
Owning a lot of stuff
might seem great, but
many things aren't that
valuable when you think
of them in terms of
real emotional value.
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
拥有很多东西可能看起来很棒，
但当你用真正的情感价值来衡量时，
很多东西并没有那么有价值。

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
Well, that might have been
a dangerous remark when
I'm trying to sell things to
customers. Still, I wish
I could carry a wider
selection of goods.
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
嗯，当我试图向顾客推销商品时，
这可能是一句危险的言论。不过，我希望
我能携带更广泛的商品选择。

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
Of course, we're here
in the middle of the desert,
so maybe I'm asking too much.
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
当然，我们在沙漠中间，
所以我可能要求太多了。

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Hey! Do you think
I can reach the bridge
over there if I jump
from over here? Do
you think you can try it?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
嘿！你觉得
如果我从这里跳过去，
能到达那边的桥吗？
你觉得你能试试吗？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
What?! You can't do it?
Well, I'm gonna be different
when I grow up! I'm gonna
be the world's best jumper!
I'm gonna be able to jump
all the way to the mooooon!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
什么？你做不到？
嗯，我长大后就会不一样了！
我要成为世界上最好的跳高者！
我要能一直跳到月亮上！

scripts.text:
[Towner]
The clothes we make here
are high, airy, and sewn
with high quality fabric.
Of course, we need to wear
stuff like this since the
weather is unbearably hot.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
我们这里制作的衣服
轻盈透气，
而且采用高品质面料。
毕竟天气热得难以忍受，
当然得穿这种衣服了。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
The fabric? Well,
I'll give you a hint.
It's made of something
related to camels. Heh!
I'll leave you to figure it
out on your own. Haha!
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
面料？
我给你个提示。
它是用某种
与骆驼有关的东西制成的。
嘿嘿！
剩下的就靠你自己去猜了。哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Let me tell you a secret.
But promise not to tell
anyone else about it, okay?
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
让我告诉你一个秘密。
但你要答应我，
不要告诉任何人，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Towner]
When the time comes,
the Temple of Cheshrumnir
will open up and the giant
Freya robot will launch!
It'll destroy every country
except Arunafeltz!
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
到时候，
瑟斯隆尼勒神殿
将会开启，
巨大的芙蕾雅机器人
将会发射升空！
它将摧毁
除了阿鲁纳菲兹以外的
所有国家！

scripts.text:
[Towner]
That robot can blow
hurricanes from its mouth,
and shoot lightning from
its horns, and it can fire
its fists away, and its
chest is a flame thrower!
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
那个机器人
能从嘴里喷出飓风，
从角上射出闪电，
还能发射拳头，
它的胸部
是一个火焰喷射器！

scripts.text:
[Towner]
..............................
You don't believe me, either.
What did you just say? Zinger?
Amazing Z? The hell's that?
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
..............................
你也不信我，对吧。
你刚才说什么？Zinger？
Amazing Z？
那是什么鬼东西？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Argh! I'm a war god
protecting Goddess Freya
and Arunafeltz! Ahhhhh!
Death to all our enemies!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
啊！我是守护
芙蕾雅女神
和阿鲁纳菲兹的战神！
啊啊啊！
消灭所有敌人！

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Burn, heretics, buuurn!
Destroy your homes, your
families, and build a new
perfect world for Freya!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
燃烧吧，异端，
烧起来！
摧毁你们的家园，
你们的家庭，
为芙蕾雅
建立一个
全新的完美世界！

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Hee hee! Doesn't that
sound wonderful! When
I grow up, I wanna be
that kind of hero!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
嘿嘿！
听起来很酷吧！
等我长大了，
我也想成为
那样的英雄！

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Fr... Fr...

[Old Man]
Fr...

[Old Man]
Praise Freya! ^333333*Keck*^000000
^333333*Cough cough*^000000 Fre...
^333333*Cough*^000000 Praise Freya!
Freya! Conquer those
that blaspheme you! Let
me see it before I die!
scripts.translation:
[老人]
赞美芙蕾雅！^333333*咳咳*^000000
^333333*咳咳*^000000 芙...
^333333*咳*^000000 赞美芙蕾雅！
芙蕾雅！
征服那些亵渎你的人！
让我在死前
亲眼看到这一幕！

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
I have never regretted
^333333*Cough*^000000 my faith in you,
my goddess! ^333333*Keck*^000000 May
the suffering of all our
enemies drive them to
madness before death!
scripts.translation:
[老人]
我从未后悔
^333333*咳*^000000 对您的信仰，
我的女神！^333333*咳咳*^000000
愿所有敌人的痛苦
让他们在死亡前
陷入疯狂！

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
I wonder what my
standing with Freya
is like. Hopefully, she
will take mercy upon me
when I leave this world.
My days here are numbered...
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
不知道我在芙蕾雅心中
地位如何。
希望我离开这个世界时，
她能宽恕我。
我的日子
所剩无几了...

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Huh? You don't live here.
Are you... Are you a traveler?
You musta been to so many
other places, huh? What
do they look like? I want to
travel too when I grow up~
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
咦？你不住在这里。
你是...你是旅行者吗？
你一定去过
很多地方吧？
那里是什么样的？
我长大后
也想出去旅行~

scripts.text:
[Kid]
I like this town, but I want
to see how other people live.
The grown-ups think it's a bad
idea, though. They say Freya
hates it. Is it that bad that
I can't stop wondering?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
我喜欢这个城镇，
但我想看看
其他人是怎么生活的。
大人们觉得
这是坏主意。
他们说芙蕾雅
讨厌这样。
真的有那么严重吗？
让我忍不住好奇。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Oh. You must be
sightseeing. Um,
Veins is a small town,
visit Cheshrumnir Temple?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
哦。你一定是
来观光的。嗯，
伯仁斯是个小镇，
要去参观瑟斯隆尼勒神殿吗？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
I hope you enjoy
your stay. Now if
you'll excuse me, I'd
like to continue with
my prayers to Freya.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
希望您
住得愉快。那么，
请原谅我，
我想继续
向芙蕾雅祈祷。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Oh, gracious Freya, your
servant humbly beseeches
you on bended knee...
Heal me of this infirmity!
The body is droopingly limp,
but the spirit is willing...!
must be... Cheshrumnir Temple.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
哦，仁慈的芙蕾雅，
您的仆人
卑微地
跪地恳求...
治愈我的病痛！
身体虽然
软弱无力，
但精神是坚定的...！
一定是...
瑟斯隆尼勒神殿。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
You know what's good
about the desert? No?
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
你知道沙漠
有什么好的吗？不知道？

scripts.text:
[Towner]
The desert makes you
stronger. Understand
what I mean? Heh, you'll
know as you spend more
time here in the desert.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
沙漠会磨练人的意志。
你明白我的意思吗？
呵呵，在这里待久了，
你自然会明白的。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner]
Unbelievable!
What kind of country
is this?! How can you
lock me up just because
I don't believe in Freya?!
scripts.translation:
[囚犯]
难以置信！
这是什么国家啊？！
仅仅因为我不信奉芙蕾雅，
你们就把我关起来？！

scripts.text:
[Prisoner]
This isn't civilized!
You're a bunch of savages
if you can't respect my
beliefs, you know that?
Someone, someone help!
scripts.translation:
[囚犯]
这太野蛮了！
如果不尊重我的信仰，
你们就是一群野蛮人，
你们知道吗？
来人啊，谁来帮帮我！

scripts.text:
[Ward]
This place ensures that
dangerous criminals aren't
threatening the publi--
Wait. Why are you even
here?! This place isn't
safe for you! Leave!
scripts.translation:
[沃德]
这里是为了确保危险的罪犯
不会威胁到公众安--
等等。你为什么会在这里？！
这里对你来说不安全！
快离开！

scripts.text:
[Ward]
I'm grateful that our
town is relatively peaceful.
If it were any other place,
that tiny cell would be
crammed full of criminals.
scripts.translation:
[沃德]
我很庆幸我们的城镇
相对和平。
如果是别的地方，
那个小牢房早就
挤满罪犯了。

scripts.text:
[Ward]
Thank Freya that I've
been assigned to such
a peaceful, quiet place.
scripts.translation:
[沃德]
感谢芙蕾雅，
我被分配到如此
和平、安静的地方。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
^333333*Pant Pant*^000000
I must study as hard as I can
for the grace of Goddess Freya.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
^333333*喘气*^000000
我必须努力学习，
以祈求芙蕾雅女神的恩赐。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
I really believe that
I can serve Freya one of
these days if I can just
expand my knowledge.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
我真的相信，
只要我不断扩充知识，
总有一天能侍奉芙蕾雅。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
It's too hot...
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
太热了...

scripts.text:
[Towner]
So sweaty...
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
好热啊，
汗流浃背的...

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Tricked you!
Thought I was dead,
didn't you? Hahaha~
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
骗你的！
以为我死了吗？
哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Towner]
The drinks in this
town are so... They're...
They're so damn strong!
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
这个城镇的酒真...它们...
它们太烈了！

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Why...
Why does the ground
keep wobbling?! It's...
It's like it's trying to
betray me! Every time!
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
为什么...
地面一直在晃动？！
它...
它好像想背叛我！
每次都这样！

scripts.text:
[Towner]
^333333*Hiccup*^000000

[Towner]
It's nice when a town
is peaceful and quiet...
But it's lame when a
tavern is dead like this.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
城镇和平安静是好事...
但酒馆像这样冷清就太无聊了。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Well, there's good
and bad points to
everything. Hopefully
things will pick up
around here as more of
you adventurers come visit.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
嗯，凡事都有优缺点。
希望随着更多冒险者来访，
这里能热闹起来。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
There's nothing but
old people and children
in this town. Where's a
decent man worth marrying?
There's a few bachelors that
are my age, but... Well...
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
这个城镇只有老人和小孩。
哪里找值得嫁的好男人？
有几个和我同龄的单身汉，
但是...唉...

scripts.text:
[Towner]
They're all too hairy or
too muscular. I don't think
I'll be able to get married
anytime soon! Oh, the misery!
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
他们要么毛太多，
要么肌肉太发达。
看来我短时间内
是嫁不出去了！
真是悲惨啊！

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Well, our town doesn't
have a choice but to
defend itself in dangerous
times. The young men we
have here are all buff and
tough to protect us.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
嗯，在危险时期，
我们的城镇不得不
自卫。我们这里的年轻男子
都强壮结实，
是为了保护我们。

scripts.text:
[Town]
They may not be beautiful,
but they have kind and
gentle hearts. It's a pity
that the women here
are more concerned
with appearances.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
他们或许不算英俊，
但心地善良温柔。
可惜这里的女性
更看重外表。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Don't judge a book
by its cover, but
by its contents.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
不要以貌取人，
要看内在。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
This storage solely
exists for serious drinkers.
If it's ever shut down,
I think everyone in town
will riot. Crazy, huh?
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
这家仓库
专为真正的酒鬼而设。
要是哪天它倒闭了，
我想全镇的人
都会闹起来。真疯狂，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Veins is famous for its
wide variety of delicious,
irresistible liquor. Just one
sip's enough to hook you.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
伯仁斯以种类丰富、
美味诱人的美酒闻名。
只要尝上一口，
你就会爱上它。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Praise Freya for
blessing us with the
gift of awesome liquor.
Her graciousness, her
compassion, her liquor
is limitless. Let us pray.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
感谢芙蕾雅
赐予我们美酒。
她的仁慈、她的慈悲、
她的美酒无穷无尽。
让我们祈祷吧。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
I really want to
ask out the woman
right in front of me.
Do you think she'll...?
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
我真想邀请
面前这位女士
出去约会。
你觉得她会...？

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Crap! Did I say that
out loud? I-I-I really
didn't want her to hear!
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
糟了！我大声说出来了？
我...我...真不想让她听到！

scripts.text:
[Towner]
I heard all that...
Gosh, he's so clueless.
I don't hate him, but he
should show a bit more
backbone if he wants
to impress me. Hmmm...
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
我都听到了...
天哪，他真迟钝。
我不讨厌他，
但如果他想给我留下好印象，
应该更有骨气一点。嗯...

scripts.text:
[Towner]
If you enjoy a good,
stiff drink, then you have
to stop by Veins Tavern~
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
如果你喜欢烈酒，
一定要来伯仁斯酒馆~

scripts.text:
[Towner]
If you don't love
drinking, then Veins
Tavern is the perfect
place to learn! ...To
love... drinking...
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
如果你不爱喝酒，
伯仁斯酒馆是学习
...如何...爱...喝酒...
的最佳场所！

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Isn't the sun so hot?
Doesn't it make you feel
so thirsty? Well, you may
want to consider quenching
that nasty thirst with liquor!
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
太阳是不是很热？
是不是让你觉得很渴？
也许你可以考虑
用美酒来解解渴！

scripts.text:
[Towner]
My job is to serve
delicious, life giving
liquor to my customers to
relieve their parched throats.
Seeing their drunken smiles
really makes my day~
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
我的工作就是
为我的顾客提供
美味、充满生命力的美酒，
缓解他们干渴的喉咙。
看到他们醉醺醺的笑容，
真是让我的一天都变得美好~

scripts.text:
[Towner]
A lone wolf of the desert.
That's me. Well, that's why
I'm drinking here alone.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
沙漠中的孤狼。
那就是我。所以，
我才在这里独自喝酒。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Sweet Freya, these
drinks are so good.
I could drink all day.
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
亲爱的芙蕾雅，
这些酒真好喝。
我可以喝一整天。

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Man, the world is just...
It's just desires...!
Faith? It helps, you
know? Cuz-cuz desires
are all just nothing!
They're nooooooothing!
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
天哪，这个世界就是...
就是欲望...！
信任？你知道的，
它很有用。因为欲望
其实什么都不是！
它们什么都不是！

scripts.text:
[Towner]
Argh! What is life?!
I don't know what to
believe anymore! Freya!
Freya looooves you!
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
啊！什么是生命？！
我不知道该相信什么了！芙蕾雅！
芙蕾雅爱你！
